bridgeGenerationBaseline.purpose: reviewed Apple API coverage input; not the installed runtime version

preparedRuntimeContract.policy: Released three-component semantic versions; historical ^/~ /=/v prefix expresses minimum metadata, not npm resolution. Core/Expo require the installed major and no newer version. NativeScript prepared runtime requires the installed iOS major/minor and no newer patch; Core and iOS versions are independent. Widget runtime/plugin exact pins remain authoritative. Public Expo runtime metadata follows the installed original UI graph across both generated mirrors; the reviewed Apple API coverage input and Hanlin bridge ABI remain independent.
preparedRuntimeContract.status: shared importer/direct-session minimum policy; numeric build precedence ignores build labels. Source pin consistency checked; full schemas and installed Host acceptance remain separate gates
